units: Sabb. VII, 2 הגוזז … והמְלַבְּנוֹ he who clips wool and he who cleanses it (by washing, removing clods &c.); Y. ib. 10ᶜ top המלבנו ההן דמגפר וכ׳ under m’labben of the Mishnah is implied (any preparation for improving raw material, e. g.) he who pitches wood &c., v. אֶלִּיקָה. Ib. המיינטון חייב משום מְלַבֵּן he who cleanses amiant (v. אַמְיַינְטוֹן) comes under the law forbidding polishing (on the Sabbath). Tosef. Ber. VII (VI), 2; Ber. 58ᵃ; Y. ib. IX, 13ᶜ top גזז ול׳ וכ׳ he (Adam) clipped (wool) and cleansed &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:12">Ab. Zar. V, 12</cite> <he>את שדרכו … לְלַבֵּן באור יְלַבֵּן וכ׳</he> such utensils as are ordinarily cleansed by being put in the fire (metal spits &c.) he must cleanse by fire.—

Gen. R. s. 70 (play on לָבָן, Gen. XXIX, 5) do you know Him שהוא עתיד ללַבֵּן וכ׳ who will cleanse your sins to make them appear like snow (Is. I, 18)?; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְלוּבָּן finished, polished, refined.

<cite ref="Niddah 31a:19">Nidd. 31ᵃ</cite> (of an embryo) <he>מל׳ ומזורז</he> well-formed and of strong vitality; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 70b">Snh. 70ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:5">Num. R. s. 10</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מל׳ ברשע</he> finished (refined) in wickedness, v. <cite ref="A02602"><he>אפדכסיס</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:13">Gen. R. s. 60</cite>; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 4:3">Ruth R. to II, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 109:11">Yalk. Gen. 109</cite>.—Esp.

<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:7">Bets. IV, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 33a:9">33ᵃ</cite>) <he>אין מְלַבְּנִין את וכ׳</he> you must not heat (new) tiles (on Holy Days) for roasting on them; Y. ib. IV, end, 62ᵈ <he>מאן דאמר מלבנין בבדוקים</he> he who says that you may heat tiles &c., refers to such as have been tested (to be sound under fire).—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Chullin 8a:1">Ḥull. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ סכין וכ׳</he> if one made a knife glowing hot and cut with it; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְלוּבָּן</he>, f. <he>מְלוּבֶּנֶת</he>. Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᶜ bot.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 23:10">Ex. R. s. 23</cite> (play on <he>שְׁלמ̇ה̇</he> a. <cite ref="U01355"><he>שַׂלְמָה</he></cite>) <he>מה השלמה הזאת מתלכלכת וחוזרת ומִתְלַבֶּנֶת</he> as the garment gets soiled and is cleansed again &c.; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 982:7">Yalk. Cant. 982</cite> <he>מתכבסת</he>).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 982:7">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6:3">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>נ׳ גופו</he> his tanned skin became white again, v. <cite ref="K01208"><he>כִּרְכֵּם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 27b:6">Sabb. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>והאונין … משיִתְלַבְּנוּ</he> bundles of flax are considered finished after they are baked; Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 5, ch. XIII.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:6">Neg. I, 6</cite> <he>היו … והִלְבִּינוּ</he> if the hair was black and turned white.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 4:4">Ib. IV, 4</cite> <he>עיקרן … וראשן מַלְבִּין</he> if their roots are black and their tops white.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 6:8">Yoma VI, 8</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11:3">Cant. R. to V, 11</cite> <he>להַלְבִּין כנף וכ׳</he> to make white one wing of a raven.
<cite ref="Yoma 39b:15">Yoma. 39ᵇ</cite> the Temple is called Lebanon <he>שמַלְבִּין וכ׳</he> because it cleanses the sins &c.—
Keth. 59ᵇ הרוצה שיַלְבִּין את בתו he who desires to make his daughter white-complexioned (handsome); a. e.—Transf. (with פנים) to put to shame, expose.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:11">Ab. III, 11</cite> <he>המַלְבִּין פני וכ׳</he> he who exposes his fellowman to shame in public.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59a:3">B. Mets. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>נוח לו לאדם שיפיל … ואל יַלְבִּין וכ׳</he> man should rather have himself thrown into a furnace than put his neighbor to shame.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 938:33">Yalk. Deut. 938</cite> <he>אני מלבין פניהם</he> I should put them to shame; (<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 44:12">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLIV</cite> <cite ref="M00184"><he>מגלה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="C00885"><he>גָּלָה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 58b:12">B. Mets. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>כל המלבין … כאילו שופך דמים</he> he who puts his neighbor to public shame is considered as if he shed blood; a. fr.—Y. Succ. V, 55ᶜ bot. (play on <he>נ̇ב̇ל̇</he>) <he>שמל̇ב̇ין כמה מיני זמר</he> it shames (excels) many a musical instrument.
